name: AdvancedSearchSrSourceDisappearance
input: one complete validating non-noop advanced_search_sr population, current Advanced Search checkpoint authority and stable LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportReader source-presence authority
population_rule: derive the current valid canonical SR identity set only after complete parse and conflict classification; a conflicting current row set still proves that canonical SR identity is present even though mutation proposals for that scope are blocked
compare only against the prior accepted Advanced Search logical population represented by checkpoint/source evidence, never arbitrary current Service Request rows
OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED is historical/correction evidence only and must not generate population-absence proposals; an older recovery workbook can never infer a new disappearance
prior_population_resolution: read the exact advanced_search_sr checkpoint and its accepted_import_run_id, source_profile_id, chronology kind/value and accepted logical fingerprint
the checkpoint run must exist and exactly agree with the checkpoint source family, source_profile_id, chronology kind/value and accepted logical fingerprint or fail INTEGRITY_FAILURE
if the checkpoint run itself is a row-bearing finalized published non-noop Advanced Search run, use it as the prior population representative

if the checkpoint run is rowless because a newer-identical/noop checkpoint advance preserved the same logical population, resolve a row-bearing finalized published Advanced Search representative with the same source_profile_id, header_registry_id, vocabulary_registry_id and parser_profile_id as the checkpoint run, the same logical fingerprint and chronology kind, and candidate chronology <= checkpoint chronology

when more than one equivalent representative qualifies, choose greatest candidate chronology, then canonical import_run_id text ascending; no matching representative is INTEGRITY_FAILURE rather than an empty prior population
a missing checkpoint means there is no prior accepted population and therefore no disappearance proposals on the first accepted Advanced Search population
proposal_construction: for each canonical SR present in the resolved prior population but absent from the complete current valid identity set, resolve the exact surviving SR through LLD-03 ServiceRequestImportReader.get_by_official

select one deterministic prior source observation for that canonical SR and bind the exact selected observation plus its own row_logical_sha256; aggregate functions may not synthesize evidence by combining values from different physical rows
read LLD-03 current_source_presence and source_presence_base_token for advanced_search_sr; warning_active suppresses duplicate disappearance proposals

an omitted prior identity without an active warning emits sr_source_disappearance_review with evidence_mode=population_absence, target_kind=source_presence, high risk, current complete import_run_id, exact prior_source_observation_id and exact SOMA_SR_SOURCE_PRESENCE_BASE_V1

the population-absence proposal fingerprint binds current complete run/profile/registry/parser/chronology/logical fingerprint, the resolved prior population run, exact prior observation identity and row logical hash, target SR identity, exact source-presence base token and immutable ProposalChangeV1
fabricate no current source observation or source field for absence
presence_freshness: source-population freshness is determined by governed Advanced Search candidate chronology, never import start time, publication time, filesystem mtime outside its declared chronology role, command time or worker time

for a disappearance proposal/event established by absence_run, a row-bearing Advanced Search run is strictly-later ordinary presence authority only when it is published outside recovery_required, uses the same registered chronology kind, has candidate_chronology_value greater than absence_run, and contains exact valid observed_valid_identity evidence for the same canonical SR

a CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT run at the same chronology does not become reappearance or disappearance-staleness authority merely by publication; only recovery finalization that replaces the source checkpoint at that same chronology may make its corrected logical population current authority

when equal-chronology recovery finalization replaces the checkpoint, resolve the checkpoint's exact row-bearing logical-population representative using the same lineage rules as prior_population_resolution; exact valid presence of the canonical SR in that representative is current presence authority
OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED never becomes automatic presence freshness authority, even if published later in wall-clock time or individually reviewed for historical/correction facts
a newer-identical rowless checkpoint carries the logical population of its resolved row-bearing representative and therefore neither fabricates nor erases canonical SR presence
acceptance_and_reappearance: acceptance invokes LLD-03 apply_source_disappearance_review and appends only governed source-presence warning history; source omission never deletes, archives, finalizes or rewrites the SR

before accepting sr_source_disappearance_review, SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider revalidates the exact absence evidence and the presence_freshness rules in the same writer UnitOfWork; if later authoritative population evidence already proves that canonical SR present, return IMPORT_PROPOSAL_STALE before appending a disappearance event
NEW_SOURCE Advanced Search publication atomically enqueues ticket_import.sr_reappearance_reconcile in the same publication UnitOfWork

CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT publication does not enqueue reappearance work; if authorized equal-chronology recovery finalization replaces the source checkpoint with the corrected run, that finalization atomically enqueue_or_coalesces the run-keyed reappearance job
OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED publication/finalization never enqueues automatic reappearance work

the bounded reappearance worker may clear an already-reviewed warning only when SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider proves the exact immutable current-run observation is presence_freshness authority relative to the active disappearance event; reappearance never recreates identity or accepts imported field values
failure_policy: checkpoint disagreement, missing accepted lineage evidence, ambiguous/inconsistent owner identity, mismatched selected prior observation evidence, superseded absence evidence, chronology-ineligible reappearance evidence or source-presence authority disagreement fails closed with no disappearance/reappearance authority
